scope: Photo-guided appearance applied to every mapped building, not an individual photograph/survey for each of 4419 buildings. Mapped footprints and heights are retained; uncertain small-building heights, roofs, material assignment and unseen facades remain labelled estimates.

photos.observation: Pale pit structure, red rails/doors and dark continuous hospitality glass.
Fairmont: recessed full-width balcony bays, pale concrete slabs and slender rails, not brick wallpaper.
Low linear pit complex with long pale roof and horizontal hospitality band. Roof event coverings vary.
Wing: angular dark/silver roof, long glazed bands, low service bays. Exact Wing roof topology is not inferred for every footprint.
White horizontal pit fascia, recessed dark bays/glazing and roof cantilever; observed from the stock-preview photograph.
Construction-era photograph: concrete open bays and glass frontage. Not proof of current temporary fit-out.
Pit tower has white floor slabs, dark windows and red upright crown; low adjacent buildings use angled pale roofs.
2009 aerial: linear white pit fascia, dark horizontal glass band and curved glazed end volume. Not exact present-day facade survey.
Completed-building photograph: exposed blond timber roof/cross-bracing, slender grey columns and glass balustrade. Original generated canopy artwork uses this palette.
White two-storey pit fascia, dark garage openings and long upper gallery/roof, not apartment windows.
Photographed hotel shell: metal diagrid, separated glazing panels with open gaps, dark horizontal floor glazing and connector. Night light colour is not baked into the daytime scene.
Redevelopment aerial photograph: low linear pit building, glazed control end, low outbuildings and sandy dune grades. Nearby small holiday/utility footprints must not all be default 9m towers.
Old City: warm coursed stone, carved window surrounds/cornices and recessed glazing; existing footprint shapes are retained, not replaced by invented photo-exact replicas.

banking.t3: User-requested gentler 10-degree peak; intentionally not the maximum real variable outer-bank angle.
banking.t14: 18-degree peak retained, shifted/blended to the curved station window; straight beyond station 801 is unbanked.

excluded_references: Montreal ConstructConnect and Parc Jean-Drapeau 2019 promotional perspective is a render, not a completed-building photograph. It was not used as photographic evidence.
Tiny 120px Suzuka thumbnail was supplemented by a larger trackside photograph.
Monza pit-entrance photo establishes track/stand context, not the garage facade.
